collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE X: GROWING UP, GROWING OLD AND EVERYDAY JOY (LCJ-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
The rest of the owner's 100 Living Culture ideas and the world-inspired 50: secret languages and forgotten words, coming of age, elders who will not retire, healers' oaths, failed discoveries, masks and clothes and masterpieces nobody wanted, talent shows, ridiculous hats and the day nobody worked.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A researcher says what is learned in the research hut should be taught to everyone: open the hut, or teach outside.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) believes that everything the researchers learn should be shared with everyone, not kept in the research hut. (friend) and the other children keep peering in the door, desperate to know what is going on inside. Some researchers say it is too dangerous for children. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) opens the research hut one afternoon a week to anyone who wants to come. The children ask four hundred questions. Something is broken. Something is discovered. (friend) decides to become a researcher.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) teaches under the fig tree instead, with safe experiments: floating and sinking, shadows, seeds. (friend) learns all of it and asks for more. The research hut stays closed, and everyone else learns anyway.
